reconstruction_notes: This original run evaluated ESMFold v1, not ESMFold2; it cannot support an ESMFold2 scientific result.
Original MMseqs hit table/reference sequences and baseline template coordinate-transfer inputs were not recovered.
Fresh model inference was not rerun. Original target structures were rescored; baseline per-unit scores are retained.
Display mean confidence intervals are new t-interval diagnostics, not the original reported standard deviations.
Template-reference means use only covered examples: 10/80 discovery A4 and 27/170 confirmation orphans. Missing baseline predictions are not zero, and their coverage differs from the target model.
The retained structures come from ESMFold v1; the intended target was ESMFold2.

Exact retained audit inputs are identified by relative filename and hash in the input inventory. A null download_source means no matching anonymous download has been established. Public upstream datasets do not substitute for missing original splits, predictions or annotations.
